cues: Robots by type: industrial arms, mobile warehouse robots, service robots like the robot waiter a Kathmandu startup built, surgical robots, drones that mapped the damage after the twenty fifteen earthquake, and explorers like the Mars rovers.
AI and robots work without tiring, fast and safely in danger.
But they cost a lot, displace jobs, lack common sense, and a model trained on biased data gives biased answers.
